# Notice

This skill reorganizes the MIT-licensed Blender Agent Skills by EL4CTEO (https://github.com/EL4CTEO/blender-skills) into one skill. See `LICENSE`.

The camera moves, Poly Haven tools, photo to 3D script and web viewer were newly written. Their ideas came from kevinbadi/blender-skills, which has no license, so none of its text or code is included.

Poly Haven assets are CC0. A tool built on the live Poly Haven API must name itself in its user-agent and visibly credit Poly Haven. Meshy is a separate paid service with its own terms.
